item.name: WebAuthn creation options for enrolling a passkey. (Roles: user)

request.description: Requires NO step-up proof, even on an account that already has 2FA: this call mutates nothing, and the only thing it exposes that the session cannot already read is excludeCredentials, whose ids GET /auth/2fa/status returns to the same session. The single proof for adding a passkey accompanies POST /auth/2fa/webauthn/register. Asking at both would cost two distinct proofs per passkey, since every proof type is single-use.

item.name: Finish passkey enrolment with the authenticator's attestation. (Roles: user)

request.description: The mutating half of the ceremony, and the ONLY place a step-up proof is required when adding a passkey to an account that already has 2FA: send exactly one of totp_code, recovery_code or webauthn_assertion alongside the attestation. First-time enrolment on an unprotected account needs no proof.
